{"invites":[{"spec_id":"spec_0551","text":"Hey all, since the last three threads about the FY budget went nowhere (no shade, I know everyone is *very* busy), I'm putting time on calendars. Thursday 3:00-4:00pm, room 204 at the district office or Teams link in the invite. All 10 of you, please, because apparently that's the only way things get read.

Agenda, with owners so nobody has to guess:
1. Quill migration licensing overage, about $18k over projection. Nico, can you walk through the vendor quote? 5 min should do it.
2. Substitute coverage line item. Teo already sent the numbers on Monday, so this is really just confirming everyone saw them. Again.
3. Transportation fuel adjustment. Zoe, quick yes/no on whether we absorb it this quarter.
4. Title I carryover. Beth and Wen, please bring the reconciled sheet, not the draft from October.
5. Hector, facilities update. Just the summary, please. We don't need every work order.
6. Open floor / anything else.

I blocked the full hour because last time we ran over, though honestly items 2 and 5 are things you can read ahead of time if you open the attachments. The only part that actually needs a decision is the Quill overage and whether we pull from contingency. Would love it if we could all show up having looked at the spreadsheet this time 🙂

If you can't make it, please let me know BEFORE Thursday morning and not ten minutes after it starts. Thanks so much!"},{"spec_id":"spec_0552","text":"Kariuki contract budget recap (AGAIN, since nobody opened the spreadsheet)"},{"spec_id":"spec_0553","text":"Elmcrest Games, Studio Huddle
